origin.description: Change the working directory until the frame exits.
origin.details: The directory is restored even when the body raises.
origin.example:
dir.create("/tmp/withr-dir-check", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
before <- getwd()
inside <- local({
  local_dir("/tmp/withr-dir-check")
  getwd()
})
c(inside, if (identical(getwd(), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Change the working directory until the frame exits.
translation.details: The directory is restored even when the body raises. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

os.makedirs("/tmp/withr-dir-check", exist_ok=True)
before = os.getcwd()
with local_dir("/tmp/withr-dir-check"):
    inside = os.getcwd()
return [inside, "restored" if os.getcwd() == before else "open"]
